text: Healthy living is about more than just eating your vegetables. A balanced diet, full of fruits, vegetables, and whole grains, gives your body the fuel it needs. Regular exercise, even a daily 30-minute walk, strengthens your heart and boosts your mood. Equally important is quality sleep, which helps your brain recover and recharge. However, mental health is often overlooked. Taking time to relax, meditating, or simply enjoying a hobby can reduce stress. Finally, strive for a healthy work-life balance. Making time for family, friends, and personal interests prevents burnout and keeps you happy. Remember, small, consistent choices lead to a healthier life.
